name: Christspiracy
rules: One idea per thumbnail. One face or one object as the hero.
Type is heavy condensed caps, white, with ONE key word in brand red. Optional serif-italic accent word. No third colour.
Max 3 words per line, max 2 lines. If you need more words the title should carry them, not the thumbnail.
Title and thumbnail complement, never repeat (Galloway).
Everything composited gets ONE global grade so it reads as a single photograph.
Check the 168px preview: if the hero and the red word are not legible at that size, it fails.
